verdict: Leads are coming in at a solid cost, but pipeline visibility needs fixing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 98 leads at an average cost of $18.55 per lead — a healthy baseline. This past week, cost per lead rose 13% while lead volume dipped 7%, though the most recent three days show volume recovering. Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply in the last 7 days, including two days with no recorded actions, which we are investigating now. Conversion tracking on the website is currently not firing correctly, so web conversion numbers under-report actual activity — a fix is in progress.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell 47% in the last 7 days, with two days of zero recorded activity, and the Weston location is generating significantly fewer calls per impression than other locations.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing all five location profiles this week and addressing the Weston listing's call performance directly.
